Extract all links from a document into metadata

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<html><head><title>Links Page</title></head><body><p>Visit <a href=\"https://example.com\">Example</a> or <a href=\"https://docs.example.com\">Docs</a>.</p><p>Also see <a href=\"/relative/path\">relative link</a> and <a href=\"mailto:hello@example.com\">email us</a>.</p></body></html>", "{\"extract_metadata\":true}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
